rules.source_quote: The applicant should be a citizen of India.
rules.note: Citizenship is not explicitly stated in the NSAP FAQ (Q13). The passage is flagged needs_recollection. This rule should be re-verified against an official NSAP source that explicitly states a citizenship requirement.

rules.source_quote: The applicant should belong to a household living below the poverty line.
The age of the applicant (male or female) should be 60 years or above.
